messages:
Sylvia: Quick sync - propose a tiny 'edge pact' manifest for runtimes across hosted/dedicated/private. Goal: <=10 keys, implementable by adapters.

Omar: Per-tenant opt-in makes sense. Minimal fields: handshake_version, capabilities[], eviction_policy.

Ben: Include observability_sink and identity_mode to avoid leaking impl details.

Andrew: Eviction difference matters (hosted prefers graceful drains; private may force). Suggest eviction_policy enum + grace_period_ms and a supports_graceful capability.

Sylvia: Also add streaming_shape: unary|streaming|mixed so control plane can emulate unsupported shapes with caution.

Ben: Example manifest:
```json
{
  "handshake_version": "1.0",
  "capabilities": ["kv_cache","streaming","graceful_eviction"],
  "eviction_policy": "graceful",
  "grace_period_ms": 30000,
  "identity_mode": "passthrough",
  "observability_sink": "prometheus",
  "egress_controlled": false
}
```

Infra Bot: infra-bot: Note: private installs should set egress_controlled=true to enable network egress validations.

Omar: Telemetry redaction settings needed: none|tenant_id|partial and allowed_tags list so private tenants can restrict tags.

Ben: Adapters must expose metric mappings (tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_p50) or advertise metrics_compat=limited. Console will normalize.

Andrew: Testing plan: small harness that probes capability manifests and runs unary, streaming, graceful drain, forced eviction flows.

Sylvia: I'll draft an RFC with enums, JSON schema, compatibility rules, and the harness plan. Timeline: 2w RFC, 1w adapter PRs. Reviewers? @Omar @Ben @Andrew @DevX Bot

Omar: I'll review.

Ben: I'll own the test harness sketch.

Andrew: I'll write telemetry normalization notes.

DevX Bot: devx-bot: Reminder set - RFC draft due in 10 days.

Sylvia: Thanks, will post RFC link here when ready.
